email.label: E-mail
email.description: The e-mail address of your PodMe account.

password.label: Password
password.description: The password of your PodMe account.

region.label: Region
region.description: The PodMe region your account belongs to. This decides which catalogue is shown.

max_episodes.label: Maximum number of episodes per podcast (0 for all)
max_episodes.description: Limits how many episodes are fetched for each podcast. The most recent episodes are kept. Useful for long-running series with hundreds of episodes.

manifest.description: Stream podcasts from PodMe, the Nordic podcast service. Requires a PodMe account; premium titles need an active subscription.
